Athletes finish two weeks of competition.

The Asian Games in Aichi and Nagoya, Japan, have ended after two weeks of competition. The closing took place on Sunday. China finished at the top of the gold medal table. This was the twelfth time in a row that China had led this table at the Games.

The Chinese team won a hundred and sixty-nine gold medals, eighty-nine silver medals and eighty-three bronze medals. Japan finished second in the gold medal table, followed by South Korea. These totals bring together results from many different sporting events.

Two athletes also received special awards. Thai runner Puripol Boonson was named the most valuable male athlete, while Chinese swimmer Yu Zidi received the female award. The end of the competition marked a chance to recognize both team results and outstanding individual performances.
